info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Warehouse Inventory Audits-v4-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Audit Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive list of inventory audits conducted within the warehouse. This endpoint is primarily utilized by inventory managers and logistics teams seeking to monitor and assess inventory accuracy. Users can retrieve detailed records of past audits, including timestamps and findings, to ensure compliance and operational efficiency. This resource is essential for those looking to enhance inventory management and maintain high standards of accuracy in warehouse operations.

get.description: Fetch a list of inventory audit entries, providing insights into inventory changes over time. This endpoint allows users to monitor and analyze the history of inventory adjustments and discrepancies.

requestBody.description: This request body retrieves the current audit details of the inventory. The payload should conform to the defined schema, which outlines the necessary properties required to fetch the audit information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the audit inventory data.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for getting inventory audit operations.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the audit request.

resultId.description: Identifier of the specific result returned in the response.

state.description: The current state of the audit.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation's result.

audit.description: Details of the audit associated with the response.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsResponse_200.description: Response schema for inventory audit operation GET request. This schema outlines the structure of the response received after successfully fetching the audit details.

createdBy.description: The user who created the audit.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the audit was generated automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Contains detailed information about the audit including who created it and when.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This value helps in understanding the performance of the API.
